name: @goreecloud/gc-ui
description: GoreeCloud UI (GC UI) — GoreeCloud's original adaptive interface design language

scripts.check: npm run tokens:check && npm test && npm run audit:colors && node tests/check-lab-references.mjs && npm run pack:check
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:interaction && npm run test:e2e:reflow && npm run test:e2e:effective-zoom && npm run test:e2e:accessibility && npm run test:e2e:visual
scripts.test:e2e:interaction: playwright test e2e/gc-ui.spec.mjs e2e/adaptive.spec.mjs e2e/forms.spec.mjs e2e/balanced-surfaces.spec.mjs e2e/environment.spec.mjs e2e/icon-atlas.spec.mjs e2e/motion-gallery.spec.mjs e2e/experience-studio.spec.mjs e2e/native-host.spec.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:visual: playwright test e2e/visual-capture.spec.mjs e2e/adaptive-visual.spec.mjs e2e/forms-visual.spec.mjs e2e/environment-visual.spec.mjs e2e/experience-studio-visual.spec.mjs --workers=1 --timeout=90000
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: playwright test e2e/gc-ui.spec.mjs e2e/adaptive.spec.mjs e2e/forms.spec.mjs e2e/effective-zoom.spec.mjs --browser firefox --workers=1
scripts.qa:native-zoom:chromium: GC_ZOOM_ISOLATED_DISPLAY=1 XDG_SESSION_TYPE=x11 GDK_BACKEND=x11 MOZ_ENABLE_WAYLAND=0 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1440x900x24' node scripts/qa-real-browser-zoom.mjs chromium
scripts.qa:native-zoom:firefox: GC_ZOOM_ISOLATED_DISPLAY=1 XDG_SESSION_TYPE=x11 GDK_BACKEND=x11 MOZ_ENABLE_WAYLAND=0 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1440x900x24' node scripts/qa-real-browser-zoom.mjs firefox
